welcome.heroTitle: Plan every trip, together, in one place
welcome.heroSubtitle: WanderPlan brings your itinerary, budget, and travel companions into a single collaborative board — no more scattered spreadsheets and chat threads.
welcome.feature1Desc: Search and save destinations with ratings, prices, and photos in rich cards.
welcome.feature2Desc: Organize your days on a Kanban-style board and catch time conflicts instantly.
welcome.feature3Desc: Track who paid what and settle up automatically, updated in real time.
welcome.footer: © 2026 WanderPlan. Built for travelers who plan together.
